lemmas.primary_translation: to have sexual intercourse for the first time / to lose innocence

definitions.translation: to have sexual intercourse for the first time (lit. lose virtue)

examples.no: gå inn for å miste dyden på neste fest
examples.en: intend to lose your virginity at the next party

examples.no: sporten har mistet dyden etter dopingskandalene
examples.en: the sport has lost its innocence after the doping scandals
